title: More Netherite
description: A mod that adds more netherite stuff to the game, such as netherite stairs, pure netherite armor, and pure netherite tools, and more.
body:
The **More Netherite Mod** adds many new features to the game, it is easy to play the mod and great for people who like to have new types of blocks, armour, and tools.

The mod adds new netherite blocks to the game. The blocks are stairs, slabs, and walls. The mod also adds new Pure Netherite items: armour and tools.

Have a great time playing the mod.

![Display of all of the features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a0d3cb3594890fe8d37b12ba3d03647dfc933ba.png)
